source: Maps each of the 27 Tutor LMS docs sections (the compendium) to its SaaS implementation plan, showing exactly what changes across every sidebar item.

sections.name: Getting Started
sections.saas_implementation: LastSaaS already provides system requirements (Go 1.25, MongoDB 7+, Node 20), permalink/per-tenant routing, download/install via Docker/Fly.io, compatible themes (tailux), and compatible plugins (Stripe, BunnyNet, Resend). Nothing new to build — this is the foundation lastsaas ships with.

sidebar_effects.Data Model: No change — users/tenants/config/roles collections already exist in lastsaas (38 base collections)
sidebar_effects.API Reference: No change — health/config/auth endpoints already exist (133 lastsaas routes)
sidebar_effects.Events: Add 2 new events: system.initialized, tenant.created (lastsaas has 22 events, +2 = 24)
sidebar_effects.Settings: No change — site_name/site_url/timezone/language already in lastsaas config store
sidebar_effects.Email Triggers: No change — no emails fired during setup
sidebar_effects.Tickets: T-001, T-002, T-003 marked DONE (foundation hardening)

sections.name: Course Builder
sections.saas_implementation: Build the course builder as a tailux-based SPA served by lastsaas. Courses collection (new), topics collection (new), lessons collection (new). The 3-step wizard (Basics → Curriculum → Additional) we already prototyped in Frontend Apps becomes the real instructor UI. Backend: new /api/courses/* CRUD routes, /api/topics/*, /api/lessons/*. Video upload to BunnyNet. Rich text editor via TipTap. All 6 modals (Lesson/Quiz/Assignment/AI/Preview/ContentBank) implemented.

sidebar_effects.Data Model: Add 7 new collections: courses, topics, lessons, course_meta, instructors, course_categories, course_tags (38 → 45 total)
sidebar_effects.API Reference: Add 16 new endpoints under /api/courses/*, /api/topics/*, /api/lessons/* (133 → 149 lastsaas routes)
sidebar_effects.Events: Add 12 new events for course/topic/lesson lifecycle (22 → 34 events)
sidebar_effects.Settings: Add 5 new settings for course defaults (66 Tutor settings → 5 mapped to lastsaas config store)
sidebar_effects.Email Triggers: Add 2 new email triggers: course_published_instructor, course_published_admin
sidebar_effects.Tickets: T-014 through T-021 (8 tickets) — in Phase 1 (Core LMS)
sidebar_effects.Build Roadmap: Phase 1 (Core LMS) — 30% complete (course builder done, curriculum done, lessons done; quizzes pending)
sidebar_effects.Frontend Apps: Course Builder app (already prototyped) becomes the real production UI — promoted from 'experiment' to 'live'
sidebar_effects.Screen Inventory: 8 new screens added to inventory (course-builder-*, lesson-modal, quiz-modal, etc.)

sections.name: Quiz Builder
sections.saas_implementation: Build the quiz builder as part of the course builder. Quizzes collection (new), questions collection (new), quiz_attempts collection (new). All 13 question types from Tutor LMS implemented as React components (multiple-choice, true-false, open-ended, fill-blanks, short-answer, matching, image-answering, ordering, puzzle, scale, coordinates, pin-image, draw-image). Backend: /api/quizzes/*, /api/questions/*. Quiz settings (20+ fields) stored in quiz_meta.

sidebar_effects.Data Model: Add 5 new collections: quizzes, questions, quiz_attempts, quiz_settings, question_answers (45 → 50 total)
sidebar_effects.Events: Add 9 new events for quiz/question lifecycle (34 → 43 events)
sidebar_effects.Email Triggers: Add 2 new email triggers for quiz completion
sidebar_effects.Quiz Types: 8 of 13 question types built in Phase 1 (free types); 5 Pro types (puzzle, scale, coordinates, pin-image, draw-image) deferred to Phase 3
sidebar_effects.Tickets: T-022 through T-025 (4 tickets) — in Phase 1
sidebar_effects.Build Roadmap: Phase 1 — 50% complete (course builder + quiz builder done)

sections.name: Quiz Question Types
sections.saas_implementation: Implement all 13 question types. Free (8): multiple-choice, true-false, open-ended/essay, fill-in-the-blanks, short-answer, matching, image-answering, ordering. Pro (5): puzzle, scale, coordinates, pin-image, draw-on-image. Each type has a dedicated React renderer (for students) and editor (for instructors). Stored in questions collection with type field.

sidebar_effects.Quiz Types: All 13 types catalogued (13/13). 8 built in Phase 1, 5 Pro types built in Phase 3. Each type links to its renderer + editor screen.
sidebar_effects.Data Model: questions collection gains a 'type' field + type-specific answer schema
sidebar_effects.Screen Inventory: 13 new question type screens added (one per type)

sections.name: Course Bundle
sections.saas_implementation: Build course bundles — group multiple courses into a single purchasable package. New collection: course_bundles. Bundle pricing, bundle thumbnail, bundle courses list. Backend: /api/bundles/* CRUD. Frontend: bundle builder UI (similar to course builder). Bundles appear in catalog alongside individual courses.

sidebar_effects.Data Model: Add 3 new collections: course_bundles, bundle_courses, bundle_pricing (50 → 53)

sections.name: Student Learning Experience
sections.saas_implementation: Build the student-facing learning interface: video player (BunnyNet), reading lessons, taking quizzes, submitting assignments, live classes (Zoom/Meet), resources downloads, Q&A, announcements, reviews, gradebook, certificate, course info, completing the course, content delivery settings.

sidebar_effects.Data Model: Add 9 new collections for student activity tracking (53 → 62 total)
sidebar_effects.API Reference: Add 17 new endpoints for student learning activities
sidebar_effects.Events: Add 14 new events for learning lifecycle (43 → 57 events)
sidebar_effects.Email Triggers: Add 7 new email triggers for student notifications
sidebar_effects.Tickets: T-026 through T-031 (6 tickets) in Phase 1
sidebar_effects.Build Roadmap: Phase 1 — 70% complete (course + quiz + learning experience done)

sections.name: Learner Dashboard
sections.saas_implementation: Build the student dashboard: home screen, my courses, notes, discussions, calendar, account menu, profile options, kids mode. tailux-based frontend with student-specific sidebar.

sidebar_effects.Build Roadmap: Phase 1 — 90% complete (dashboard is last in Phase 1)

sections.name: Instructor Dashboard
sections.saas_implementation: Build the instructor dashboard: home, courses, announcements, quiz attempts, assignments, discussions, live classes, certificate, analytics (statements tab), notifications panel, profile menu, account settings.

sections.name: Native eCommerce
sections.saas_implementation: Build native eCommerce: cart, checkout, payment methods, coupons, taxes, orders. Reuse lastsaas Stripe integration for payment processing. New collections: carts, orders, coupons, taxes, order_items. Backend: /api/cart/*, /api/checkout/*, /api/orders/*. Stripe webhook handles order.paid event chain.

sidebar_effects.Payment Gateways: Stripe integration already exists in lastsaas — extend with course-specific order handling
sidebar_effects.Tickets: T-037 through T-042 (6 tickets) in Phase 2

sections.name: Payment Gateways
sections.saas_implementation: Integrate all 11 payment gateways: Stripe (already in lastsaas), PayPal, Paddle, Authorize.net, Paystack, Mollie, Klarna, Alipay, Razorpay, 2Checkout, Manual Payment. Each gateway implements a common PaymentGateway interface. Backend: /api/gateways/* for configuration, /api/gateways/:id/process for payment.

sidebar_effects.Payment Gateways: All 11 gateways catalogued. Stripe built in lastsaas (Phase 0). 10 more added in Phase 2. Each gateway = 1 settings screen + 1 webhook endpoint.
sidebar_effects.Data Model: Add 3 new collections: payment_gateways, gateway_configs, transactions (76 → 79)
sidebar_effects.Tickets: T-043 through T-046 (4 tickets) in Phase 2

sections.name: Subscriptions
sections.saas_implementation: Build subscription-based course access. Reuse lastsaas Stripe subscriptions. New collection: course_subscriptions. Students pay monthly/yearly for ongoing access. Dunning management for failed payments. Backend: /api/subscriptions/* CRUD.

sections.name: Memberships
sections.saas_implementation: Build membership tiers — students buy a membership that grants access to a group of courses. New collection: memberships, membership_courses. Backend: /api/memberships/* CRUD. Frontend: membership builder, membership pricing page.

sections.name: Gift Course
sections.saas_implementation: Build gift course feature — user purchases a course for someone else. New collection: course_gifts. Backend: /api/gifts/* CRUD. Frontend: gift purchase flow, gift redemption page.

sections.name: Admin Panel
sections.saas_implementation: LastSaaS already provides the admin panel: courses, categories, tags, students, instructors, announcements, Q&A, quiz attempts, tutor themes, addons, tools, pro license. These are the lastsaas /admin/* routes. LMS-specific admin pages (courses, students, instructors) added in Phase 1.

sidebar_effects.Data Model: No change — admin uses existing collections
sidebar_effects.API Reference: No change — admin endpoints already exist in lastsaas

sections.name: Tutor LMS Settings
sections.saas_implementation: Map Tutor LMS's 66 settings to lastsaas config store. lastsaas already has a config store with dynamic reloading from MongoDB. LMS-specific settings (course monetization, design, advanced, legal consents, gradebook, email, notifications, authentication, certificate, accessibility, license) added as config keys.

settings: ALL 66 Tutor LMS settings mapped to lastsaas config keys

sidebar_effects.Settings: All 66 Tutor LMS settings catalogued. Each maps to a lastsaas config key. 11 settings pages built (one per category).
sidebar_effects.Data Model: No change — config collection already exists

sections.name: Tutor LMS Addons
sections.saas_implementation: Build the 21 Tutor LMS addons as feature flags in lastsaas. Each addon is a feature flag + a package of code (collections + endpoints + events + frontend). Addons: Course Preview, Prerequisites, Attachments, Content Drip, Assignments, Email, Reports, Social Login, Notifications, Gradebook, Certificate, Multi Instructors, Calendar, Google Meet, Google Classroom, Zoom, H5P, WPML, BuddyPress, WooCommerce Subscriptions, Paid Memberships Pro.

sidebar_effects.Settings: 21 new feature flag settings (one per addon)
sidebar_effects.Tickets: T-066 through T-086 (21 tickets) in Phase 3-4
sidebar_effects.Build Roadmap: Phase 3-4 (Pro Authoring + Pro Engagement) — addons built incrementally

sections.name: Certificate Builder
sections.saas_implementation: Build a visual certificate design canvas using react-konva. Instructors design certificate templates (backdrops, layers, media library, text). Students receive certificates on course completion. New collection: certificates, certificate_templates. Backend: /api/certificates/* CRUD.

sidebar_effects.Frontend Apps: Certificate Builder app — planned (next after Course Builder)

sections.name: Integrations
sections.saas_implementation: Build third-party integrations: WooCommerce (already have Stripe), Easy Digital Downloads, Kadence Memberships, BunnyNet (video CDN), Loco Translate. Each integration = a config screen + webhook handlers. Backend: /api/integrations/* CRUD.

sections.name: Elementor Integration
sections.saas_implementation: SKIP — Elementor is a WordPress page builder plugin. Our SaaS uses tailux (React), not WordPress. No equivalent needed. The 38 Elementor doc pages are reference-only for understanding Tutor LMS's WordPress-specific widgets.

sidebar_effects.Note: SKIPPED — WordPress-specific, no SaaS equivalent. tailux replaces Elementor.

sections.name: Divi Integration
sections.saas_implementation: SKIP — Divi is a WordPress page builder. Same as Elementor. No SaaS equivalent needed.

sections.name: Oxygen Builder Integration
sections.saas_implementation: SKIP — Oxygen is a WordPress page builder. Same as Elementor/Divi. No SaaS equivalent needed.

sections.name: Tutorials
sections.saas_implementation: REFERENCE ONLY — 33 tutorial pages (Frontend Course Creation, Enabling Q&A, Translating, Instructor Signup, Student Signup, Guest Purchase, etc.). These are how-to guides for end users, not implementation specs. Use as UX reference for our help docs.

sidebar_effects.Note: REFERENCE ONLY — used for UX patterns and help documentation, not direct implementation.

sections.name: Migration
sections.saas_implementation: Build migration tools: WooCommerce to Tutor LMS, LearnDash to Tutor LMS, LifterLMS to Tutor LMS, LearnPress to Tutor LMS. Since we're building a new SaaS (not migrating from WordPress), this becomes an IMPORT tool for customers coming from other LMS platforms. New collection: migrations. Backend: /api/migrations/* CRUD.

sections.name: Tutor LMS Shortcodes
sections.saas_implementation: SKIP — WordPress shortcodes are WordPress-specific. Our SaaS uses React components instead. The shortcode functionality (embedding courses, dashboards, etc.) is replaced by tailux page routes.

sidebar_effects.Note: SKIPPED — WordPress shortcodes replaced by tailux React routes.

sections.name: Advanced Customization
sections.saas_implementation: Build customization tools: override templates (tailux theme system), edit dashboard, add course levels, auto-approve instructors, add custom registration fields, disable WP cron for mailing (use lastsaas jobs runner instead).

sections.name: Troubleshooting
sections.saas_implementation: REFERENCE ONLY — 8 troubleshooting pages (order not completed, 404 error, certificate emails not sent, nonce mismatch, can't create quiz options, Yoast/RankMath issue). Use as QA checklist for our SaaS testing.

sidebar_effects.Note: REFERENCE ONLY — used as QA checklist for testing.

sections.name: Developer Guides
sections.saas_implementation: Build developer-facing API: action hooks (lastsaas events), filter hooks (lastsaas middleware), REST API (already have /api/*), custom payment gateways (PaymentGateway interface), custom fields in course builder. This is the public API documentation for SaaS customers who want to extend the platform.

sidebar_effects.Data Model: Add 2 new collections (98 → 100 total — matches our target of ~100 collections)
sidebar_effects.API Reference: Add 8 new /api/dev/* endpoints (172 Tutor endpoints → all mapped)
sidebar_effects.Events: All 480 Tutor events mapped to lastsaas event system
sidebar_effects.Tickets: T-098 through T-100 (final 3 tickets) in Phase 5
